_comment: Bot roster — one entry per bot account (this file holds secrets: keep it out of git, see bots.json). Generate api_key with: python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(24))'. Optional "triggers" fire when the bot receives a message (not from itself) in a matching room; see README 'Triggers'.

triggers.command: opencode run --standalone -m ollama/qwen3.8:27b-mtp-q4_K_M-128k "You got a new message in matrix channel {{channel}}: {{msg}}"
